desc: Choose approach: prefix-count F(n) via memoized digit DP over (started, sum, product); zero-product numbers automatically beautiful; exact product feasible without capping.
Implement F(n) counting beautiful integers in [1, n]; return 0 when n ≤ 0.
Handle leading zeros via started flag; base case counts only when started, sum > 0, product % sum == 0.
Memoize shared `free(rem, started, s, p)` states reused across F(r) and F(l-1).

Verify solution: provided examples (10,20)→2 and (1,15)→10 pass; brute-force cross-check for ranges up to 5000 and random ranges to 10^6 pass; edge cases (l=r, l=1, r=10^9-1, zeros like 100/101/2000) pass; worst-case timing ~0.3s, sub-second.
